subject: Proposed Performance Action Plan for Markus K.
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed Performance Action Plan for Markus K.

Hi Mina / Laura / Aditya,

I need to initiate a formal performance action plan for Markus Klein (Platform Infra). Over the past 6 months I've documented recurring issues across reliability ownership, missed deadlines on Priority A milestones, and repeated escalation patterns despite coaching. I've attached a draft PIP and the performance log that compiles specific incidents (timestamps, owner handoffs, customer impact).

High-level ask: can HR and Legal review the attachment and confirm (1) whether the proposed goals and success criteria are sufficient, (2) if the 60-day timeline is appropriate, and (3) any language we should change to reduce legal risk. I want to keep this discrete until we confirm wording / next steps.

Proposed timeline (subject to your feedback):
- This week: HR & Legal redlines and calibration meeting with Aditya + me
- Week 1: Manager delivery + 1:1 to go over expectations (we will provide written PIP)
- Week 3 & 5: Formal checkpoints with documented outcomes
- End of Week 9 (60 days): Final review and next steps (extension / role change / termination if unmet)

Attachments: markus_pip_draft.docx (draft PIP), performance_log_markus_q4_q1.csv (evidence).

Key points to consider from my side:
- I have documented 7 discrete incidents that point to pattern (see attached)
- Markus has had multiple informal coaching sessions and a documented 30-day improvement plan was attempted last quarter
- My intention is to be clear about measurable expectations and provide support (mentorship hours, weekly check-ins) while protecting the company and impacted customers

Please let me know availability for a 30-minute calibration today or tomorrow. If Legal prefers to have an external counsel consulted, flag here and loop them.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- markus_pip_draft.docx (PIP template populated)
- performance_log_markus_q4_q1.csv (rows: date,incident,impact,owner,link)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed Performance Action Plan for Markus K.

Thanks for pulling this together, Evelyn. I reviewed the draft and the attached log — good level of specificity, which will help if we need to escalate. A few immediate edits from HR:

- Goal framing: convert a couple of the "general improvement" bullets into measurable objectives (example: reduce incident reopen rate by X% / complete Y on-call runbooks).
- Support plan: explicitly list the support resources (mentor, weekly 1:1 schedule, training) and who will own each item.
- Communication: include a short script for the manager conversation and a timeline for written acknowledgement.

I've attached a version with tracked changes (markus_pip_v2.docx). Two HR notes: do not reference potential termination dates verbatim — we prefer options phrased as "further action may be considered" and we keep the right to extend the plan for additional time if reasonable. Also confirm whether any protected accommodations are in place; if so, HR will need to adjust timeline/expectations.

Calibration: I'm available 14:00–16:00 PT today or 09:30–11:00 PT tomorrow. I recommend we invite Aditya for higher-level alignment.

Mina Haddad
Senior HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- markus_pip_v2.docx (HR edits: measurable goals + support schedule)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nicole Turner <nicole.turner@cornerstonelaw.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed Performance Action Plan for Markus K.

Evelyn / Mina — I reviewed markus_pip_v2 and have a few legal redlines (attached as PDF). Summary of recommended edits: 

1) Wording: replace any implication of immediate termination (e.g., "termination at the end of the plan") with conditional language: "If the required outcomes are not met, the company may consider further disciplinary action up to and including termination subject to applicable policies."
2) Documentation: ensure each checkpoint is documented in the employee's file; avoid language that could be construed as punitive without giving an opportunity for remediation.
3) Confidentiality & privacy: remove detailed medical/personal speculation from the PIP; if disability/medical accommodation is disclosed, route to HR only.
4) Evidence retention: advise retention schedule for the performance_log_markus_q4_q1.csv and any interview notes — recommend 3 years for investigatory records.

I've looped external counsel (Nicole Turner) on this thread as a precaution because the proposed outcomes include potential role change; Nicole, please weigh in if you see issues with the proposed timeline or phrasing.

Attachments:
- legal_redlines_markus_pip.pdf (redline + comments)

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, People & Employment
Redwood Inference
